lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਅਮਰੁ ਏਕਾ ਪਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਕਾਰ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: eko amar ekaa patisaahee jug jug sir kaar banaaee he ||1||
lines.translation: There is only One Command, and there is only One Supreme King. In each and every age, He links each to their tasks. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: so jan niramal jin aap pachhaataa ||
lines.translation: That humble being is immaculate, who knows his own self.
The Lord, the Giver of peace, Himself comes and meets him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa sabad ratee gun gaavai dar saachai pat paaee he ||2||
lines.translation: His tongue is imbued with the Shabad, and he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; he is honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||2||
The Gurmukh is blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam.
The self-willed manmukh, the slanderer, loses his honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam rate param ha(n)s bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laaee he ||3||
lines.translation: Attuned to the Naam, the supreme soul-swans remain detached; in the home of the self, they remain absorbed in deep meditative trance. ||3||
That humble being who dies in the Shabad is perfect.
The brave, heroic True Guru chants and proclaims this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਮਨੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar a(n)mrit sar saachaa man peevai bhaai subhaaee he ||4||
lines.translation: Deep within the body is the true pool of Ambrosial Nectar; the mind drinks it in with loving devotion. ||4||
The Pandit, the religious scholar, reads and instructs others,

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਜਲਤੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar jalate kee khabar na paae ||
lines.translation: but he does not realize that his own home is on fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੜਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ਹੇ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve naam na paaeeai paR thaake saa(n)t na aaee he ||5||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, the Naam is not obtained. You can read until you are exhausted, but you shall not find peace and tranquility. ||5||
Some smear their bodies with ashes, and wander around in religious disguises.
Without the Word of the Shabad, who has ever subdued egotism?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੇਖਿ ਭਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: anadin jalat rahahi din raatee bharam bhekh bharamaaee he ||6||
lines.translation: Night and day, they continue burning, day and night; they are deluded and confused by their doubt and religious costumes. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਮਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਉਦਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik grih kuta(n)b mahi sadaa udaasee ||
lines.translation: Some, in the midst of their household and family, remain always unattached.
They die in the Shabad, and dwell in the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sadaa rahahi ra(n)g raate bhai bhaai bhagat chit laaee he ||7||
lines.translation: Night and day, they remain forever attuned to His Love; they focus their consciousness on loving devotion and the Fear of God. ||7||
The self-willed manmukh indulges in slander, and is ruined.
The dog of greed barks within him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jamakaal tis kade na chhodai a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaaee he ||8||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death never leaves him, and in the end, he leaves, regretting and repenting. ||8||
Through the True Word of the Shabad, true honor is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin naavai mukat na paavai koee ||
lines.translation: Without the Name, no one attains liberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਐਸੀ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur ko naau na paae prabh aisee banat banaaee he ||9||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name. Such is the making which God has made. ||9||
Some are Siddhas and seekers, and great contemplators.
Some remain imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Formless Lord, day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਉ ਜਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: jis no aap milaae so boojhai bhagat bhaai bhau jaaee he ||10||
lines.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord unites with Himself; through loving devotional worship, fear is dispelled. ||10||
Some take cleansing baths and give donations to charities, but they do not understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੈ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik manooaa maar manai siu loojhahi ||
lines.translation: Some struggle with their minds, and conquer and subdue their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਇਕ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: saachai sabad rate ik ra(n)gee saachai sabad milaaee he ||11||
lines.translation: Some are imbued with love for the True Word of the Shabad; they merge with the True Shabad. ||11||
He Himself creates and bestows glorious greatness.
By the Pleasure of His Will, He bestows union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਇਉ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape nadar kare man vasiaa merai prabh iu phuramaaee he ||12||
lines.translation: Bestowing His Grace, He comes to dwell in the mind; such is the Command ordained by my God. ||12||
Those humble beings who serve the True Guru are true.
The false, self-willed manmukhs do not know how to serve the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape karataa kar kar vekhai jiu bhaavai tiu laaee he ||13||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself creates the creation and watches over it; he attaches all according to the Pleasure of His Will. ||13||
In each and every age, the True Lord is the one and only Giver.
Through perfect destiny, one realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਵਿਛੁੜੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਦਰੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabad mile se vichhuRe naahee nadaree sahaj milaaee he ||14||
lines.translation: Those who are immersed in the Shabad are not separated again. By His Grace, they are intuitively immersed in the Lord. ||14||
Acting in egotism, they are stained with the filth of Maya.
They die and die again, only to be reborn in the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਮਨਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੇ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur seve mukat na hoee man dekhahu liv laaee he ||15||
lines.translation: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds liberation. O mind, tune into this, and see. ||15||
